packageRules.description: Run `go mod tidy` after a cli/ Go bump so go.sum gets the module-content (h1:) hashes, not just the /go.mod hashes. Without it Renovate updates cli/go.mod but leaves go.sum incomplete, and any job that compiles cli/ fails with `missing go.sum entry` — notably generated-go-cli, which builds the buf tool via `go generate`. gomodTidy runs in the module's own directory, so it needs no path handling. Mirrors the a-novel service repos.

customManagers.description: Keep the a-novel-kit/workflows action pins in the repocfg governance caller templates current. Renovate's built-in github-actions manager only scans real .github/workflows/ files, not these CLI templates, so without this manager the pins go stale and `a-novel repo update` re-deploys an outdated (or load-broken) action version fleet-wide.
